name: bonsai-2026-10-12
description: The Bonsai worker as it ran on 2026-10-12 (garden/bonsai-agent), except worker memory is off (memory is W3) and the session timeout is 20 minutes, not 45.
worker_description: Bonsai 2 27B (Ternary-Bonsai-2-27B, 2-bit), a local model on this machine's GPU

sources.model: autopilot/README.md 'History': to go back to Bonsai set the worker to garden/bonsai-agent; autopilot.py worker_agent_dir() registers it from agent/models.bonsai-agent.json
sources.thinking: autopilot/README.md 'History': garden/bonsai-agent with thinking low; same as evals/arms/baseline.json
sources.max_output_tokens: agent/models.bonsai-agent.json maxTokens 16384; autopilot.py do_work() cut-off message cites the 16k limit
sources.compaction_reserve_tokens: autopilot.py worker_agent_dir(): settings compaction.reserveTokens 28672 for provider garden
sources.session_timeout_min: Changed on purpose: config.json worker_timeout_min was 45; W1 milestone sets 20
sources.worker_memory: Changed on purpose: config.json worker_memory was mem0; W1 milestone sets it off
sources.extensions: autopilot.py worker_agent_dir() copies extensions/submit_request.ts into the agent dir
